files.hint: Codex config for a sub2api Grok group (grok-4.6)
files.content:
# Codex config for a sub2api Grok group (grok-4.6).
#
# Required environment variable:
#   SUB2API_KEY=sk-...
#
# Notes:
# - Do not use model_reasoning_effort = "none"; sub2api rejects it.
# - xhigh requires sub2api >= 0.0.27 (older gateways flatten it to high).

model = "grok-4.6"
model_provider = "sub2api"
model_reasoning_effort = "xhigh"

approval_policy = "on-request"
sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"

[model_providers.sub2api]
name = "sub2api"
base_url = "${apiBase}"
env_key = "SUB2API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"
request_max_retries = 0
stream_max_retries = 0
stream_idle_timeout_ms = 60000

params.name: ${providerName}
